market_summary: Major instruments are predominantly consolidating or pulling back late in the New York session after strong earlier trend moves. XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD remain depressed below their session VWAPs and EMA50s but are lacking volume or breakdown momentum at lower support levels. US100 and BTCUSD maintain bullish high-timeframe posture above VWAP/VAH, but are currently rejecting near overhead resistance levels (Gamma Flip/Put Wall on US100 and Session High on BTCUSD) with light volume. All symbols reflect HOLD signals pending fresh session catalysts.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4016.16) and below POC (4044.01). CVD is -2.77 (BEARISH) aligning with downward trend. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is testing Session Low support around 3982.41. Mid-range extension after a prolonged sell-off warrants a HOLD.
